topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I can't believe this. I walk into the gallery, expecting to see my pieces, the ones I poured my soul into, and what do I find? Someone's added their own twist—no, not a twist, a defacement. My brushstrokes, my colors, now overshadowed by someone's permanent ink. It's not just the art that’s been altered; it's my expression, my voice. I didn’t invite this duet. This wasn’t a collaboration; it was a violation. The gallery walls mock me with their altered faces, each stroke a scream I can’t ignore. How did this happen? Who thought this was a good idea?
